method: Subset: Rv0678 all-missense, no atpE/pepQ (n=312, 143 clusters). GroupKFold(5) by variant-set key. StandardScaler + LR(C=0.5, balanced). Baseline structure vs exploratory biophysical (Grantham distance, recognition helix alpha4, helix breakers).
interpretation: Original structure achieves AUC ~0.56-0.57 (pre-registered negative baseline). Exploratory biophysical features show an unvalidated subset signal (AUC ~0.688). These features are NOT in the production model and have not been validated externally.
caveats: DNA chains are a modeled complex. Grantham matrix captures radical vs conservative substitutions. Exploratory subset only (n=312); balanced class weighting deviates from production calibration.
supports: Reproduces the pre-registered E08 negative baseline; documents an exploratory subset hypothesis.
